decisions.backfill: none: vectors stored before v20 have no ledger row and are re-embedded at most once when a later duplicate needs them

queries.name: columns-generation_text_hashes
queries.sql: SELECT name,CASE WHEN upper(type) LIKE '%INT%' THEN 'INTEGER' WHEN upper(type) LIKE '%TEXT%' THEN 'TEXT' ELSE 'OTHER' END,"notnull",dflt_value,pk FROM pragma_table_info('generation_text_hashes') ORDER BY cid

queries.name: indexes-generation_text_hashes
queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN il.origin='c' THEN il.name ELSE NULL END,il."unique",il.origin,il.partial,ii.seqno,ii.name FROM pragma_index_list('generation_text_hashes') il JOIN pragma_index_info(il.name) ii ORDER BY il.origin,il."unique",il.partial,il.name,ii.seqno

queries.name: partial-index-predicates
queries.sql: SELECT name,lower(replace(replace(replace(substr(sql,instr(upper(sql),'WHERE')+5),' ',''),char(10),''),char(13),'')) FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='idx_generation_text_hashes_copied' ORDER BY name

queries.name: without-rowid
queries.sql: SELECT name,upper(replace(replace(replace(sql,' ',''),char(10),''),char(13),'')) LIKE '%)WITHOUTROWID' FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='generation_text_hashes' ORDER BY name

queries.name: column-count
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pragma_table_info('generation_text_hashes') WHERE name IN ('generation_id','chunk_id','text_hash','copied')

queries.name: v20-marker
queries.sql: SELECT identifier FROM grdb_migrations WHERE identifier IN ('v19_folder_rag','v20_embedding_dedup') ORDER BY identifier
